verdict.rationale: Caveman is an agent workspace and token-compression product, so bulk operations are a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence documents a way to select or act on many items at once. The orchestrator that starts multiple chats (caveman-docs-7) and automations that run by hand, on a schedule or on a GitHub event (caveman-docs-11) are adjacent features, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
